Shares of Bumble saw a significant increase, which rose nearly 52% after the acquisition discussions became public. The company is facing challenges in a competitive market, particularly with younger users disengaging.

title: Indian Gas Exchange secures Sebi's nod to float IPO

The proposed IPO is exclusively an offer for sale of equity shares by promoter Indian Energy Exchange Ltd. IGX aims to enhance its visibility and strengthen its brand image through this public listing. The company has been operational since June 2020 and reported increasing revenue in recent years.

As part of the settlement, the firm has paid Rs 40.5 lakh. The infractions included not maintaining the required interest in the Singularity Equity Fund and excessive drawdowns in three of its schemes.
